scope: synthetic frame-causal two-channel WPE comparison at a task-local protocol-shaped waveform adapter boundary; no selection, superiority, real-room, device, listening or release claim

public_boundary.registration: none; this task adds no C provider, descriptor, registry entry, installed default or public catalog entry
public_boundary.note: Installed v0 stays 16 kHz mono f32, 160 samples/frame. The 2x160 f32 in / 160 f32 out shape exists only at this opt-in task-local Python boundary.

invariants: Only this task directory is written; no shared SDK file, CMake, contract, public header, registry, default or installed behavior changes.
The reference is frame-causal: two current 160-sample frames and strictly earlier frames only; a divergent later stereo frame cannot change emitted frames.
Each emitted 160-sample frame uses a 480-sample causal content delay and a three-frame zero flush; chunked and single-stream f32 digests match.
Echo-only, near-end-only, overlap and no-reference cases are present; no missing result qualifies the candidate.
Nonfinite, invalid, missing-channel, delayed-channel, out-of-range and stale-state inputs fail closed without mutating DSP state.
Pinned offline whole-clip WPE results are a labeled noncausal upper-bound control, never an oracle, threshold, candidate result or acceptance gate.
Synthetic SI-SDR/STOI and the late-tail energy proxy are not real-room echo attenuation, listening scores or release evidence.
Exact three cold-start f32 digests are used; no tolerance widening or provider substitution.
source_evidence_statements: candidate_matrix.csv row 65: WPE offline/online/multichannel is an evaluated dereverberation candidate with synthetic EARS/SMARD screens and mixed target/RTF outcomes, not an installed SDK provider.
adapters/wpe/README.md: 512-point FFT, 128-hop, 5 taps, 8-frame delay and roughly 80 ms algorithmic latency; the documented offline use is not real time.

REALTIME_COMPONENT_CANDIDATES.md line 60: three-channel online WPE had median RTF 0.044 on a measured SMARD screen and no material quality benefit over mono WPE on that direct-dominated set; provenance only, not reproduced here.
research/dereverberation_candidates_20261028.md: multichannel WPE is stateful and frame-causal; measured gains over identity were effectively zero and room/target choices changed outcomes.
blockers: No held-out real-room or standards-room paired dereverberation evaluation with pinned RIR provenance, rights and a defined early-reflection target has been run.
No listening/MOS assessment on licensed real speech has been run; synthetic STOI is not a human score.
No target-device CPU, memory, deadline, pacing or content-delay measurement has been run for any causal variant.
No render/echo-return alignment or delayed/missing render evaluation has been run for any AEC-style scope.
No provider intake, rights, license, descriptor and public catalog review has been completed for a realtime v0 provider.
reopening_conditions: Provide real-room or standards-room RIR pairs with pinned provenance and a defined early-reflection target, then rerun paired SI-SDR/STOI with identity and noisy controls.
Run listening/MOS with licensed real speech and a declared listener protocol.
Measure the causal variant on the exact target device at the 160-sample grid before any realtime v0 provider proposal.
Close the render/echo-return delayed/missing case before any AEC-style qualification.
Complete provider intake, license and descriptor review before changing any installed default, registry or public catalog.
